hebrewText: וְ/אִ֨ם בְּ/אֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִוָּסְר֖וּ לִ֑/י וַ/הֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖/י קֶֽרִי

an-(the) other; one sort, so, some, such, them, these (same), they, this, those, thus, which, who(-m).
